# glyph-kit (vendored)

`core.mjs`, `text.mjs` and `layout.mjs` from [glyph-kit](https://github.com/alextraykov/glyph-kit) v0.3.0 (commit `6f48bf3`), MIT licensed. Unchanged; `pp overview` draws its charts with them. `core.d.mts` types the functions pp uses.

To update, copy the three files from `skills/glyph-kit/scripts/` of a newer release and check `pp overview` still draws.
